picks.rule: an outlier dim is the commonest per-token argmax of |x| over the layer's 32 tokens; Qwen's massive unit is token 0's argmax of |SiLU(gate) * up|; the sink head is the head with the largest mean softmax weight on key 0 over queries 16-31 (fp32's tile), the least-sink head the smallest (fp16's tile); each cut takes the aligned block (64, 32 or 16 wide) holding the outlier

quantisation: activations: q = clip(round_half_even(x / s), -127, 127), s = the token's max abs over its whole row / 127 (the checkpoints' dynamic per-token symmetric int8); weights: the checkpoints' own int8 values
forward: layers 0-3 in float32: RMSNorm -> W8A8 q/k/v (int8 x int8 exact, x token scale x channel scale, + bias for Qwen) -> rotary (rotate_half over 64 dims) -> scores q.k/8 with grouped KV heads -> causal softmax -> P V -> W8A8 o_proj -> residual -> RMSNorm -> W8A8 gate, up -> SiLU(gate) * up -> W8A8 down_proj -> residual
